instructions.description: Stand beside support with one foot slightly ahead of the other.
Keep both feet fully supported and look forward.
Hold the position with relaxed breathing.
Switch the lead foot and repeat.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record time maintained before using support or changing foot position.

variations.variationDescription: Feet-Together Balance provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Semi-Tandem Balance.
Tandem Stance meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Semi-Tandem Balance.
Semi-Tandem Balance — Wider-Base Balance Version: Increase the base of support to reduce balance demand.
